title: benchhand finding
description: One problem a service reports, such as a record validation finding. code is stable and names the rule; message is for people and may change. error blocks; warning and info never do

path.description: The file the finding is about, relative to the project root, with / separators

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the document at path; for a CSV file /<row index>/<column>

subject.description: What the finding is about, for grouping: a part number or a document id

examples.message: record_version 2 is not supported; this release reads record_version 3
examples.action: Migrate the record; nothing was changed.
